message:
Hey friends! 🌟 Have you ever thought about how we can turn the idea of preparedness into a cozy family event? This resource is a wonderful way to help our kids learn about safety while having fun together. We can explore it as a family activity, turning discussions about emergencies into opportunities for bonding and creativity. 

Let’s make it a game – maybe even create our own family safety plans and do some role-playing! Who knows, it might just become our new favorite tradition. How do you involve your little ones in these conversations?
